Aggregate abundances by glycan or glycopeptide identifier

step_aggregate.Rd

Apply glyclean::aggregate() to the active experiment. With to_level = NULL, glyclean selects the level from the experiment type and available structural annotations, as in its former auto_aggregate().

Usage

step_aggregate(
  to_level = NULL,
  standardize_variable = TRUE,
  f = sum,
  seed = 123
)

Arguments

to_level

The aggregation level. If NULL (the default), glycomics data uses "gs" when glycan_structure is present and "g" otherwise; glycoproteomics data uses "gfs" when glycan_structure is present and "gf" otherwise. Explicit values are: "g" (glycan compositions), "gs" (glycan structures), "gf" (glycoforms), "gp" (glycopeptides), "gfs" (glycoforms with structures), or "gps" (glycopeptides with structures). See Details for more information.

standardize_variable

Whether to call glyexp::standardize_variable() after aggregation. Set to FALSE to skip network calls for faster testing. Default is TRUE.

f

A function applied to each group's values separately for each sample. Defaults to sum. Missing values are removed before calling f, which must return one numeric value, including for an empty vector when all values are missing. For example, use mean, max, or function(x) mean(x, trim = 0.1).

seed

Non-negative integer seed for random number generation. Default is 123. The caller's random state is restored, including on errors.

Value

A glysmith_step object.

Examples

step_aggregate()
#> <step "step_aggregate()"> Aggregate abundances
step_aggregate(to_level = "gf", f = mean, standardize_variable = FALSE)
#> <step "step_aggregate(to_level = \"gf\", f = mean, standardize_variable =
#> FALSE)"> Aggregate abundances
